title: Sensitivity (recall): the missed-case floor
caption: Share of real disease cases the model flags. The DR contract sets this above 90% because a missed diagnosis is the expensive failure — every FN is a patient sent home untreated.

symbols.name: sensitivity
symbols.meaning: true-positive rate; share of actual positive cases correctly flagged

symbols.name: true positives
symbols.meaning: diseased patients correctly flagged for referral

symbols.name: false negatives
symbols.meaning: diseased patients cleared as healthy — the catastrophic miss

title: Specificity: the false-referral budget
caption: Share of healthy patients correctly cleared. Above 80% keeps the specialist referral load within clinic capacity — a 90%-healthy population means every specificity point is paid in real referrals.

symbols.name: specificity
symbols.meaning: true-negative rate; share of actual healthy patients correctly cleared

symbols.name: true negatives
symbols.meaning: healthy patients correctly cleared, no referral

symbols.name: false positives
symbols.meaning: healthy patients flagged for referral — consumes scarce specialist capacity

title: Ungradable share: the lab-to-field gap measured
caption: Beede et al. 2020: of 1,838 retinal images captured in Thai clinics, 393 were ungradable — about one in five patients effectively unscreened despite a specialist-level lab model.

symbols.name: rejected share
symbols.meaning: fraction of field images too degraded to grade

symbols.name: ungradable count
symbols.meaning: images rejected by quality requirements — 393 in the Thailand deployment

symbols.name: submitted count
symbols.meaning: all images captured at the clinic — 1,838 in the study

title: Constraint-propagation rework
caption: The bill when a constraint surfaces late: every dependent artifact revised, its dependent work repeated, and the result re-validated. Day-153 priced at five months plus a six-day sequential repair.

symbols.name: total rework
symbols.meaning: cost of the late constraint, summed over all affected artifacts

symbols.name: dependent artifacts
symbols.meaning: artifacts built on decisions the constraint invalidates — dataset, weights, validation results

symbols.name: revision cost
symbols.meaning: work to correct artifact a against the newly surfaced constraint

symbols.name: repetition cost
symbols.meaning: re-running the dependent pipeline stages for artifact a

symbols.name: re-validation cost
symbols.meaning: re-establishing the release evidence for artifact a — the term that usually dominates

title: Iteration tax: search breadth per window
caption: Ideas tested is window divided by cycle time — a weekly loop clears ~26 candidates in six months, an hourly loop ~100. The tax buys search breadth, not accuracy per se.

symbols.name: experiments possible
symbols.meaning: how many candidates or fixes a team can try inside the window

symbols.name: development window
symbols.meaning: calendar time available, e.g. six months

symbols.name: cycle time
symbols.meaning: wall-clock for one full loop — train, validate, or both

title: Iron law, additive form: stage ownership map
caption: Chapter 1's time equation read as an org chart: data stage sets D_vol via capture resolution, model stage sets Ops via backbone choice, deployment stage sets R_peak, η, and L via device and runtime.

symbols.name: task time
symbols.meaning: one training run or one screening inference

symbols.name: data volume
symbols.meaning: bytes moved per task — set by capture resolution at the data stage

symbols.name: memory bandwidth
symbols.meaning: bytes/s the machine delivers — a device property

symbols.name: operation count
symbols.meaning: FLOPs per task — set by architecture choice (~600 MFLOPs for MobileNetV2)

symbols.name: peak rate
symbols.meaning: theoretical FLOP/s of the target machine

symbols.name: utilization
symbols.meaning: fraction of peak actually realized — set by runtime and data feeding

symbols.name: fixed overhead
symbols.meaning: dispatch, launch, and sync costs per task

title: Feasible operating point: the ROC pass corner
caption: The first validation check: does any single classification threshold satisfy both floors under intended conditions? Sweeping τ traces the ROC curve; if no point reaches the corner, the candidate fails before deployment questions start.

symbols.name: decision threshold
symbols.meaning: probability cutoff that turns the model's score into a binary referral

symbols.name: sensitivity at τ
symbols.meaning: lowering τ catches more disease (raises this) at the cost of more false referrals

symbols.name: specificity at τ
symbols.meaning: raising τ clears more healthy patients (raises this) at the cost of missed cases
